t8017.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Abū Jaʿfar al-Muʾadhdhin al-Anṣārī al-Madanī as acceptable, of the third generation, and says whoever claims he is Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn has erred; cited by al-Bukhārī and others.

t8163.bio: Ibn Ḥajar states that Abū al-Shumūs al-Balawī is a Companion who has a ḥadīth.

t8291.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Abū ʿAyyāsh al-Zuraqī al-Anṣārī as a Companion who narrated a hadith on the prayer of fear, witnessed Uḥud and later battles, and died after the year forty; his name is disputed.

t8435.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Abū al-Ward al-Māzinī as a Companion who settled in Egypt. His name is disputed: Ḥarb, or ʿUbayd ibn Qays, or Thumāma ibn Nuhayk. He has one hadith.

t8686.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Malīkah bint 'Amr al-Sa'diyyah, concerning cows' milk; it is said she has Companionship and it is said she is a Successor, of the third generation.

t925.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records al-Jaʿd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Aws as trustworthy, of the fifth generation; he died in 44 AH.
